verdict.rationale: Base44's Superagents docs say workflows can run on a schedule as well as on event triggers, which covers recurring scheduled workflows rather than just one-off actions. The evidence is a single sentence with no detail on how schedules are set up or how often they can run. Missing for 10: documented schedule configuration (frequency/cron options, time zones), run history or monitoring, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: A workflow runs on a schedule or when a trigger happens, such as activity in a connected tool.
